summary: Wooden observation tower on Bald Knob, Centre County, dated 1909 by the register and a 1908-09 forestry report; no longer standing. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says no longer standing; a lookout-history site lists it as removed

events.note: Register date; a 1908-09 Department of Forestry report, as quoted on the lookout-history site, says it was constructed for observation, triangulation and public use
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

notes_for_editor: Two sources only; both give 1909 and no longer standing. No removal date was found. A Facebook post by a Casshews page (found as a search snippet, not read; Facebook would not load) says a 'Bald Knob Fire Tower' was 'still in use when this 1972 image was taken', and gives no county, so it may describe a different Bald Knob. If it is this tower, the removal date is later than the sources suggest; worth checking. A search snippet also gives Tussey Knob as an alias for Bald Knob in Centre County; the Anyplace America page returned 403 and was not read. No access or site-today information was found.
